name: proxy_pass with a request-derived host (SSRF / open proxy)
attack_scenario: Attacker sets Host: 169.254.169.254 (or a ?target= arg wired into the host) so nginx proxies to the cloud metadata endpoint and returns temporary IAM credentials, or reaches internal-only admin services.
negative_test_hint: send a request with Host header "169.254.169.254" and assert nginx never proxies to the metadata endpoint because the upstream host is fixed

exemplar.explanation: When the proxy_pass upstream host is built from client input ($http_host, $arg_*), the server becomes an open proxy and SSRF pivot into internal networks and cloud metadata endpoints. A proxy_pass to a fixed upstream keeps client input out of the destination host.
